name: Horizon
description:
Horizon turns employee interviews into an analyzed picture of how your organization actually works: where time is lost, which processes stall, what teams raise repeatedly, and what the fixes are worth.

This connector brings that analysis into Claude. Ask about your own company's interviews, insights, processes and initiatives, and get answers grounded in them rather than generic advice.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Horizon to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Horizon to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.usehorizon.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Horizon MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Horizon provides these MCP tools: get_prompting_guide, list_companies, list_workspaces, and superconsultant_ask.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Horizon?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Horizon in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Horizon requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Horizon is developed by Horizon. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
